claims.text: Greg Short asserts that the most dangerous entrepreneurial failure mode is not the loss itself but the behavioral avoidance that follows it: taking a setback and becoming a skittish entrepreneur — one who stops taking risk or action — is the outcome he fears most when working with entrepreneurs.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: entrepreneur who has recently experienced a business setback or loss

practices.text: After taking a loss on any given day, reset your mental scoreboard to zero the following morning — not negative, not carrying forward any previous score. Treat each day as a fresh start regardless of what happened the day before.
